pairs.question: Si pupillus pupillave cum iusto tutore tutorve cum eorum quo litem agere vult et curator in eam rem petitur, utrum ipsis poscentibus datur an vero et adversario?
pairs.answer: Et sciendum est, sive agant sive conveniantur, dari hunc curatorem posse, sed non alias, quam si ipse petat, cui dari eum oportet.
pairs.derivation: The jurist poses a disjunctive question (utrum...an vero...?) and answers it himself. Setup kept (Si pupillus... petitur) so the curator and the alternatives have a referent. Answer ends at the first full stop; what follows (denique cassius libro sexto scripsit...) is supporting elaboration on the rule and is cut.

pairs.question: Duo sunt titii, pater et filius: datus est tutor titius nec apparet, de quo sensit testator: quaero, quid sit iuris?
pairs.answer: Is datus est, quem dare se testator sensit: si id non apparet, non ius deficit, sed probatio, igitur neuter est tutor.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaero, quid sit iuris) with the verbatim factual setup needed to make it intelligible; terminal period normalized to ?. The framing 'respondit:' is dropped as a speech tag. The answer is the whole reply, which is a single contiguous sentence answering the question.

pairs.question: Quaero, an non eiusdem civitatis cives testamento quis tutores dare possit?
pairs.derivation: An indirect question introduced by Quaero, an... functioning as the real interrogative, answered by Paulus's reply. The answer is kept whole (it is a single short sentence); 'Paulus respondit' names the responder rather than narrating the asking, and the operative answer is 'posse'.

pairs.question: Cum codicillis ideo alios tutores dare significasset, quoniam testamento datos quosdam defunctos aut excusationem habere posse comperisset, an nihilo minus qui eorum viverent nec excusati essent, tutores permanerent?
pairs.answer: Respondit nihil proponi, cur non permanerent.
pairs.derivation: Real question (an...permanerent?) with its verbatim circumstantial setup (Cum codicillis... comperisset). Answer is the entire one-sentence reply; the speech tag is retained only as part of the answer sentence 'Respondit nihil proponi...'.

pairs.question: Avia nepotibus curatorem dedit fideicommisso ei relicto: quaesitum est, an administrare curator compelli debeat?
pairs.answer: Respondit curatorem quidem non esse, sed cum aliquid ei testamento datum esset, teneri eum ex fideicommisso, si non curam susciperet, nisi id quod ei datum esset nollet petere aut reddere esset paratus.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaesitum est, an... compelli debeat) with verbatim setup. The whole reply forms one sentence that genuinely answers (he is no curator, but is bound by the fideicommissum); kept entire as a single contiguous span.

pairs.question: Item quaesitum est, an iste curator satisdare nepotibus debeat?
pairs.answer: Respondit quasi curatorem non debere, sed cum fideicommissum ab eo peti posset, fideicommissi nomine satisdare debere.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaesitum est, an... debeat) directly answered. 'iste curator' refers to the avia's appointee of the immediately preceding paragraph, so the question is self-contained as a follow-on; answer is the single contiguous reply sentence.

pairs.question: Proinde si alter ex patronis filium, alter nepotem reliquerit, utrum ad solum filium an vero et ad nepotem tutela pertineat, quia et nepos in familia patris sui proximus est?
pairs.answer: Hoc apparebit ex legitimis hereditatibus: legitima autem hereditas ad solum filium pertinet.
pairs.derivation: Author poses a disjunctive question (utrum...an vero...?) and answers it himself. Setup (Proinde si alter ex patronis...) kept so 'filium/nepotem' have referents. Answer cut at the second full stop; the following 'ergo et tutela ad solum filium descendit...' is the inference drawn from the stated answer and is omitted.

pairs.question: Seiae egressae annos duodecim decreto praetoris ex inquisitione datus est tutor quasi minori: quaero an excusare se deberet?
pairs.answer: Respondi secundum ea quae proponerentur neque excusationem necessariam esse neque obligari quod non gereret.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaero an... deberet) with verbatim factual setup so 'excusare se' has a subject. Answer is the entire one-sentence reply; 'Respondi' names the responder. No interior ellipsis.

pairs.question: Sine herede tutor decessit: quaero, an curator pupillo datus, cum neque inventaria neque alia instrumenta a fideiussore tutoris exhibeantur, possit eundem fideiussorem convenire ex stipulatione, quanti pupilli interest?
pairs.answer: Modestinus respondit in id quod tutor conveniri potuit, fideiussorem quoque conveniri posse.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaero, an... possit... convenire) with verbatim setup (Sine herede tutor decessit). Answer is the whole single-sentence reply; 'Modestinus respondit' names the responder.

pairs.question: Lucius titius curator gaii seii tempore curae fundum cornelianum locavit sempronio, qui sempronius reliqua traxit: pupillus aetate probata eundem quondam colonum sempronium fecit procuratorem: quaero, an ex eo, quod ille ut procurator egit, omne debitum adulescens agnovisse videatur eoque nomine curatorem suum liberasset?
pairs.answer: Paulus respondit non ex eo, quod adultus eum, qui praedia eius coluit, procuratorem habere voluit, debitum, quod ex conductione reliquatus est, adgnovisse eum videri.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaero, an...) with the verbatim narrative setup needed for the referents (Lucius Titius, Sempronius, the procurator appointment). Answer is the whole single-sentence reply; 'Paulus respondit' names the responder.

pairs.question: Tutor rerum italicarum conventus a creditore provinciali, ubi rem pupillus habuit, solvit: quaesitum est, an id tutelae iudicio reputari potest?
pairs.answer: Respondit nihil proponi, cur non possit.
pairs.derivation: Real question (quaesitum est, an... reputari potest) with verbatim setup giving 'id' its referent (the payment). Answer is the entire one-sentence reply.

pairs.question: Chirographis debitorum incendio exustis cum ex inventario tutores convenire eos possent ad solvendam pecuniam aut novationem faciendam cogere, cum idem circa priores debitores propter eundem casum fecissent, id omisissent circa debitores pupillorum, an, si quid propter hanc cessationem eorum pupilli damnum contraxerunt, iudicio tutelae consequantur?
pairs.answer: Respondit, si adprobatum fuerit eos tutores hoc per dolum vel culpam praetermisisse, praestari ab his hoc debere.
pairs.derivation: Real question (an... consequantur?) with its verbatim circumstantial setup (Chirographis... pupillorum). Answer is the single contiguous reply sentence giving the conditional rule.

pairs.question: Defendente tutore pupillus condemnatus ex contractu patris accepit curatorem, inter quem et creditorem acta facta sunt apud procuratorem caesaris infra scripta. priscus procurator caesaris dixit: "Faciat iudicata". novellius curator dixit: "Abstineo pupillum". priscus procurator caesaris dixit: "Responsum habes: scis, quid agere debeas". quaesitum est, an secundum haec acta adulescens a bonis patris abstentus sit?
pairs.derivation: Whole-speech-as-question: the verbatim setup including the quoted exchange before the court is kept contiguous, and the operative interrogative is 'quaesitum est, an... abstentus sit'. Answer is the entire one-sentence reply (he was withdrawn). Speaker labels in the recorded acta are the author's own words within the cited document, not conversion-artifact drama labels, so they are retained.
